messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — we're doing a split Identity Provider cutover next week: Okta remains the IDP for hosted accounts, Keycloak will be the primary IDP for Private/VPC deployments. Planned migration window: Thu Mar 28 02:00-04:00 UTC. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/idp-split-2026. Please skim and flag any owned apps that need special handling. @eng-security @devex :eyes:

Frank Liu: Thanks Maya. A couple questions: will we force re-auth on first login after cutover? Also need to schedule SCIM token rotation and audit exports. We'll prep the rotation playbook and post commands here. :lock:

Olga Novik: DevEx note — terraform modules and our auth helper libs will get new variables (KEYCLOAK_ISSUER, OKTA_AUDIENCE). Self-hosted runner configs that use OIDC will need the audience claim update. I'll open PRs to the templates today.

Sam Rivera: Eng-Infra: We'll do a staged rollout to limit blast radius — orgs in 50s (alpha), then 100s (beta), then full. We'll also run a pre-cutover smoke job that hits the auth endpoints and CI flow. For bot/service accounts we'll run the rotation script:
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
./scripts/rotate-service-account.sh --org $ORG --idp-key new-key.pem
```
Expect a ~2 minute downtime for affected bot tokens during rotation.

ci-bot: scheduled runbook entry created: /migrations/idp-split/1799994321. Tests: auth-smoke v1 -> PASS, ci-login -> PASS. Will kick off periodic checks during window.

Sophie Kim: Product question — how will this affect SSO links for customers who log in via org SAML? My team needs messaging copy if we expect login prompts or reconsent flows.

Maya Patel: Great q. Short answer: some users may see a reconsent prompt for GitHub SSO and may need to reauthorize third-party apps. We'll publish a customer-facing FAQ and a short status banner template. Rollback plan: if we see >3% auth error rate in 20 minutes we pause and re-enable the SAML bridge (legacy-idp-bridge) for the affected org(s). Steps are in the runbook under "rollback".

Frank Liu: We'll also enable additional logging (OIDC.request_id, saml_request_id) so support can trace quickly. I'll add a Kibana dashboard for the migration.

Olga Novik: PRs: terraform-provider-auth #412, runner-templates #89. Marking them as migration-critical. Will tag @sam for infra changes.

Sam Rivera: Noted. We'll coordinate cutover groups in the sheet at https://sheets.redwood/IDP-cutover and use the oncall rotation: @oncall-auth. I'll post ingress throttling knobs in the runbook.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — please RSVP to the sync Fri 10:00 PT if you're owning any of the checklist items. If anyone sees immediate blockers in the runbook, drop them here. :tada:
